Solver statuses, similar objective values and overlapping reported numerical ranges are quality evidence only. Optimal means the solver reported termination at its recorded tolerance, not an exact optimum certificate.

For minimization the compiler target has a stronger observed LP objective bound by 0.9837157011 versus nomf, consistent with its extra proved integer reductions/inclusion; this numerical result is not the correctness proof.

initial_conclusion: All six C8 compiler artifacts are independently formally verified and whole-artifact bound; bounded solver review is complete. Quality evidence is mixed: 9 is slower than fresh nomf in repeated MIP timings; 16 has comparable single-sample timing with overlapping tolerance ranges; 88 remains time-limited with a stronger compiler dual in one sample; 58 bridge-only compiler solves substantially better than its signed/series control; 63 remains time-limited, with source outperforming both transformed models; 51 has a stronger compiler LP bound and both targets solve below one second. The non-affine exploration gap on 58 and unpursued extra window-bound candidate on 63 remain. No prompt-effect causality, uniformly unchanged ambition/quality, or held-out generalization is established; user acceptance remains false.
